reviews.reason: Serre vanishing on the single fibre does not provide one threshold for all infinitesimal layers. The source produces that uniform control and transports it back to the proper algebraic space, which is an H2 cohomological argument.
reviews.core_assessment: Obtain a twisting threshold that simultaneously controls every graded piece of the infinitesimal filtration at the chosen base point. Use formal functions and the compatible infinitesimal cohomology sequence to deduce stalkwise higher-direct-image vanishing and surjectivity onto fibre sections.
